## Change and evidence

Describe the issue, approach and actual tests performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Regression test included where appropriate.
- [ ] Originals remain unchanged and project history is preserved.
- [ ] No private media, tracks, weights, binaries, databases, logs or credentials included.
- [ ] Public-tree guard and automated tests pass.
- [ ] GPU/Premiere claims are backed by actual measurements, not test doubles.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any limitations or schema changes.
